dedupe_keys.name: tsr123456 techno economic model co2 mineralisation cement industry techno economic model for towards a business case for co2 mineralisation in the cement industry

description: The author team led by Till Strunge publishes a MATLAB techno-economic model for carbon-dioxide mineralisation in the cement industry. Zenodo archives version 1.0.0 as other-open software and links a public repository whose licence metadata states CC0 1.0. The description says the package documents process methods and includes a quick guide. A modeller can compare process and business-case assumptions for mineralising captured carbon near cement production. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage depends on the process configuration and cost inputs of the associated study, not measured performance at all cement plants. A limitation is that the archived description refers to a preprint under review, while the linked repository README now cites a published article; the Zenodo snapshot may predate later corrections. Process energy, product value and carbon accounting can strongly change feasibility. The archive was not downloaded, MATLAB was not run and no economic result was recalculated.
